CREATE TABLE dbo.RoundRobinTable
(
    TransactionID BIGINT,
    CustomerID INT,
    ProductID INT,
    Amount DECIMAL(10,2),
    EventDate DATE
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);
